name: Gnarlpine Hold
summary: Gnarlpine Hold is a secluded hollow located in the far southwestern reaches of Teldrassil. Once a dwelling place of the native Gnarlpine furbolg tribe, the hold has succumbed to foul demonic corruption, becoming a volatile front line for the defenders of the boughs.

sections.title: A Corrupted Bastion
sections.body: Tucked away in the southwestern corner of Teldrassil, Gnarlpine Hold was historically inhabited by the local Gnarlpine furbolgs. In recent times, dark demonic corruption has taken root deep within the hollow, displacing or tainting its former residents and bringing forth sinister fiends. A persistent stream of demonic invaders now spills northward from the hold, where the dryad Tarindrella and the stalwart ancients of Teldrassil hold the line in an ongoing battle to cleanse the World Tree.

faq.answer: Gnarlpine Hold lies tucked away in the far southwestern corner of the World Tree Teldrassil, southwest of Dolanaar.
The hollow was formally home to the Gnarlpine furbolg tribe before corruption spread across their settlements and displaced them.

faq.q: Why are there demons in Gnarlpine Hold?
faq.answer: Demonic corruption has recently seized the hollow, manifesting directly within its borders and turning the once-peaceful furbolg haven into an active breach of foul entities threatening Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who is fighting against the corruption coming from the hold?
faq.answer: Just north of the hold, the dryad Tarindrella and several awakened Teldrassil ancients stand vigilant, confronting the demonic forces that spill out from the corruption below.

angles.text: The demonic presence in Gnarlpine Hold represents a direct violation of Teldrassil's sanctity, prompting swift action from local dryads, ancients, and night elf defenders.
For druids attuned to the health of the World Tree, the blight and demonic intrusion festering within Gnarlpine Hold are a stark reminder of the fragile balance on Teldrassil.
